card.name: Inside non-Latin script characters
card.fires_on: Single characters partway through words in non-Latin scripts such as Greek, Lao, and broken byte characters, and occasionally a lone letter inside a Latin word. Seen mostly in dictionary or reference text giving foreign spellings.

modes.label: Lao script letters
modes.description: A single Lao letter inside the Lao national motto.
